source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical-Body and Chassis, p.12-40

procedures.title: Directional signal switch: general service notes
steps: Replace the switch as an assembly if faulty; only the cancelling and detent springs on one of the two designs can be serviced (see figure 54 in the manual).
Follow Steering, Section 9, for any work on the energy-absorbing column; this section only supplements it.
notes: All models have lane-change and hazard warning functions.
The hazard warning needs an extra flasher in the fuse panel able to run up to six lamps at once; signal flasher units differ by number of lamps.
The switch replacement steps on this page are for Chevrolet, Chevelle, Chevy II and Camaro only.
